newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup to buy Belgian rail caterer.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup to buy Belgian rail caterer.

text.p: SAirGroup, the holding company for airline Swissair, said its SAirRelations division had signed an agreement in principle to buy Belgian railroad caterer Restobel.
SAirGroup said Restobel, with annual sales of 440 million Belgian francs, would be integrated into the Swiss group's Rail Gourmet business.

It said Restobel, a unit of Belgian group AviaPartner, specialised in catering and logistical services for trains between Belgium, France, Germany and the Netherlands as well as the Eurostar line between France and England.
SAirGroup said it had signed an agreement in principle in Brussels and the deal must now be approved by Belgian authorities.
"The transaction is expected to be closed by the end of April," the statements aid.
It said the price for Restobel, which has 280 employees, would not be made public.
